response.overview: NASA documentary on Apollo 13, April 1970. Two days out from Earth an oxygen tank ruptured, and the mission became a rescue: James Lovell, Jack Swigert and Fred Haise used the Lunar Module as a lifeboat while flight controllers in Houston improvised the procedures that brought them home. Not to be confused with the 1974 ABC television movie of the same title.
response.title: Houston, We've Got a Problem
